summary: Iteration 4 - multi-company (multiaziendale). Backend: 14/14 new pytest tests pass (tenant via X-Company-Id, companies CRUD, duplicate P.IVA on create/update, missing header 400, unknown/non-assigned company 404, cross-company isolation of parties/articles/invoices incl. xml/send/refresh/delete, 'Cliente non trovato' when using other company's party, per-company numbering 1/2026 + progressivo 00001, scoped dashboard, delete company blocked with invoices / cascades parties+articles+counter+user company_ids otherwise, PATCH/POST users company_ids validation & dedupe, non-admin scoping, auth regression incl. bcrypt $2b$, httpOnly cookie, 5-fail lockout -> 429). Frontend (Playwright, desktop): no-company screen for admin -> CompanyDialog (validation toast, success) -> lands on /impostazioni; /aziende create, duplicate P.IVA toast, open (switch), delete with invoices blocked toast, delete success (also deleting the active company falls back to another); sidebar switcher scopes dashboard/fatture/anagrafiche/articoli/dati azienda; active company persists on reload; UserDialog 'Aziende assegnate' checkboxes + Users 'Aziende' column + company card 'Utenti assegnati'; contabile without companies sees 'Nessuna azienda assegnata' (no create button); contabile with stale localStorage id is reset to his assigned company, sees only it, no Aziende/Utenti nav, /aziende redirects; print page for active company OK; send/refresh SDI (simulated) in UI OK with filename IT<piva>_00001.xml. All features requested work. Only minor issues found.

minor.issue: Old regression files test_fatturazione_api.py / test_iteration2_features.py / test_iteration3_users_sdi.py do not send X-Company-Id and use sessions that no longer exist -> they now fail en masse. They are outdated, not app bugs; replaced by test_iteration4_*.py

ui_bugs.issue: Opening the print URL of an invoice belonging to another (non-active) company stays forever on 'Caricamento…' - the Promise.all has no catch for 404. Should show an error / suggest switching company or redirect.
Opening /fatture/<id> of another company silently redirects to /fatture without any toast explaining why.

integration_issues.issue: Active company is read from localStorage on every request by the axios interceptor. If the user switches company in tab B, tab A still shows company X UI/data but its next requests (e.g. create invoice / save party) go to company Y -> data written to the wrong company. Suggest keeping the company id in React state/context for the header (or listening to the 'storage' event and reloading/forcing re-gate in other tabs).

action_items: Handle 404 in InvoicePrint (and show a toast in InvoiceEditor) when the invoice belongs to a different company
Fix multi-tab company mismatch: source X-Company-Id from in-memory context or sync tabs via window 'storage' event
Optional: CompanyContext.reload has no error handling - if GET /companies fails the app stays on 'Caricamento…' forever
Optional: update/retire legacy test files that no longer send X-Company-Id
critical_code_review_comments: server.py tenant(): solid; admin bypasses company_ids as intended; _push_status updates by id only but always after _get_invoice(company check) - OK
delete_company cascades parties/articles/counter and pulls company_ids from users - OK; it does not touch invoices because it is blocked when invoices exist - OK
users can retain stale company ids only if inserted manually (API validates); GET /companies just filters, harmless
server.py is 969 lines (>700) - consider splitting into routers (auth, users, companies, invoices)
CompanyContext.reload() lacks try/catch -> infinite loading on API error
